content.tagline: High-performance all-in-one care: fewer steps, more radiance
content.descriptor: KIFT, a Korean all-in-one cosmetics brand; manufacturing through certified partners
about: KIFT COMPANY is the owner and developer of KIFT, a Korean brand of high-performance all-in-one cosmetics. The brand concept is care that does it all in one: a single product addresses several skin needs and reduces a multi-step routine of 6–10 products to a single step. The company positions itself as the brand owner and formulation developer rather than as an in-house manufacturing plant; finished products are made through certified Korean manufacturing partners.

The lineup is built around four all-in-one formats — a serum, creams, a leave-on bubble care mask and a cleansing bar for face and body. Key products: Multi-Solution Face & Eye Serum, Multi-Solution Miracle Mask Cream, Multi-Solution Air Glow Cream, Super Bubble Mask All-In-One and Multi-Solution Face & Body Soap. The formulas combine several cosmetic actives in a single step — birch sap, fermented filtrates, hyaluronic acid complexes, ceramides and botanical ingredients.

KIFT is known for its crowdfunding launches on the Korean platform Wadiz and is preparing to enter international markets: in September 2026 the company is taking part in K-EXPO MEXICO in Mexico City. The core cooperation format is wholesale supply of the brand's finished products on EXW Suwon terms. Clinical and marketing materials are the company's own data, provided at the deal stage and not reproduced on the site as independently verified. For open markets, including Latin America, materials are published through Teranova.

lines.name: All-in-One Serum
lines.note: Multi-Solution Face & Eye Serum — a multifunctional all-in-one serum based on birch sap: care for tone, hydration and age-related skin changes in a single step. 30 ml.

lines.name: All-in-One Cream
lines.note: Multi-Solution Miracle Mask Cream — a nourishing barrier cream with a ceramide and hyaluronic acid complex; Multi-Solution Air Glow Cream — a lightweight cream with Galactomyces ferment filtrate for hydration, barrier care and a fresh glow. 50 ml.

lines.name: All-in-One Mask
lines.note: Super Bubble Mask All-In-One — a leave-on bubble care mask for overnight skin recovery that works as a mask pack without a sheet base. 100 ml and 28 ml (trial) formats.

lines.name: All-in-One Soap
lines.note: Multi-Solution Face & Body Soap — a cleansing bar with French clay (20%) for face and body: cleansing and clay care in a single product. Original and Deep at 85 g each, Discovery Kit at 20 g x 2.

tech.name: A focus on all-in-one care
tech.note: Multifunctional all-in-one formulas where a single product covers several cosmetic tasks. The company provides clinical and marketing materials after a contract; on the site they are not reproduced as independently verified, with no medical claims.

tech.name: Manufacturing through certified partners
tech.note: Finished products are made through certified Korean manufacturing partners; the company's package includes two manufacturer documents for CGMP/ISO standards (per company data). The company does not claim to have its own plant as a fact.

tech.name: Registrations and standards
tech.note: Per company data, part of the SKUs have an EU CPNP notification (the package includes three CPNP notifications; updated documents for individual items, including Multi-Solution Air Glow Cream and the reformulated serum, are expected by mid-August 2026), as well as US MoCRA listings. This is company data and registration references, not regulatory approval; copies of supporting documents are provided at the deal stage.

formats: Cleansing bars for face and body
content.exportNote: KIFT brand products are available on the Korean market, including through crowdfunding launches on the Wadiz platform. The company is preparing to enter international markets: in September 2026 KIFT is taking part in K-EXPO MEXICO in Mexico City (September 24–27) and plans to work with Latin American buyers. For open markets, materials are published through Teranova.

terms.label: Cooperation formats
terms.value: Wholesale supply of KIFT brand finished products — eight SKUs across serum, cream, bubble mask and cleansing bar formats.

terms.label: Minimum order
terms.value: The minimum order unit per the price list is one case per SKU; a separate price is set for pallet orders. The overall MOQ for a first order is clarified at the deal stage.

terms.label: Prices
terms.value: EXW Suwon, Korea; in USD excluding VAT; on request / to be clarified. Separate prices for case and pallet orders. For orders placed by the end of August 2026, the company offers a promotional term — marketing materials and samples in a volume equivalent to roughly 3% of the first order amount.

terms.label: Logistics and paperwork
terms.value: A forwarder appointed by the buyer files the Korean export declaration with KIFT Company as exporter of record and provides the seller with a copy of the export permit within seven days of shipment. Delivery terms depend on the destination country; samples are discussed separately.

terms.label: How it works
terms.value: Request → Teranova review and alignment → negotiations and samples → logistics, customs and payment, turnkey.

content.consentNote: The data and materials are provided by KIFT COMPANY (the KIFT brand) and published with its written consent dated 03.08.2026 to feature the brand and materials on the Teranova platform and present them to prospective international partners. The supplier's direct contacts are not disclosed. Teranova coordinates and supports the deal.

catalog_notes: A multifunctional all-in-one serum for face and eyes on birch sap (67%) with bakuchiol, adenosine, niacinamide, glutathione and hyaluronic acid; hydration, radiance and firmness care in a single step, 30 ml.
A multifunctional mask cream for restoring the protective barrier with a 5-ceramide complex, hyaluronic acid, panthenol, red ginseng peptide and bakuchiol; deep hydration and skin nourishment, 50 ml.
A lightweight all-in-one cream with 57% Galactomyces ferment filtrate, niacinamide, bakuchiol and a 5-ceramide complex; weightless hydration, protective barrier care and a natural skin glow, 50 ml.
An all-in-one bubble overnight mask with niacinamide, tranexamic acid, adenosine, panthenol and an 11-complex of hyaluronic acid; overnight hydration, radiance and cosmetic tone evening, 100 ml.
A multifunctional face and body soap with 20% French clay, sulfur, tannins and plant oils (jojoba, olive, avocado); cleansing, clay-mask-like care and gentle exfoliation, 85 g.
A multifunctional face and body soap in the Deep version for deeper cleansing — with 20% French clay, sulfur, tannins and plant oils; cleansing, clay care and exfoliation, 85 g.
A discovery set with the multifunctional face and body soap: two bars based on 20% French clay with sulfur, tannins and plant oils for cleansing and clay care, 20 g x 2.
